overview_description.description: Hood provides a device for users’ cars that is synced with Hood’s mobile application. The app informs the user when an error is detected and whether it is minor or requires immediate attention. Users can also check and clear the code of the engine light, track their trip history, locate the nearest car shop, keep their gas expenses in check, monetize the car’s movement and have a big cloud of data of every mile driven. Hood also offers insurance companies and executives regular customized reports of their clients’ most recurrent car breakdowns, allowing them to determine their best insurance policy. The app’s smart dashboard displays new offers, specials discounts and loyalty programs to customers.
